explanation: Requested point (W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=90 deg) is physically valid for eta electroproduction: W is above the p+eta threshold (1.486132 GeV), Q2 and W both fall exactly on the EtaMAID-2023 interpolation grid nodes defined in mpintp.inc (Q2 step 0.05 GeV2, W step 10 MeV in the 1.5-2.0 GeV range), so no extrapolation warning is needed. Electron-side kinematics at the standard CLAS12 beam momentum (6.53 GeV) give a positive scattered-beam-momentum and cos(theta_e) within [-1,1] (theta_e ~ 10 deg), and the radiative phase-space bound vmax computed in bornkin() is positive (~0.138 GeV2), confirming the exclusive reaction is kinematically allowed at this point and is below the standard vcut=0.166 GeV2 (so vmax is not artificially clipped by the cut). cos(theta*) and phi* are within their allowed physical ranges. No fixes were required; I generated a single-point input file using the standard CLAS12 defaults documented in eta/README.md and eta/examples/README.md: model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) radiative correction), bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0.0 (fixed target), lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (recoil proton detected), vcut=0.166 GeV2 (CLAS12 eta-analysis inelasticity cut), N=1 point with W=1.6, Q2=1.0, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=90. The trailing legacy NAG-library comment line is preserved as required by the Fortran reader per the documented input format.
